channel.title: Robotics Directory - Educational Robots
channel.description: Browse 169 educational robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: D. Creative DIY ESP32 Robot Dog
item.description: DIY 3D-printed robot dog build powered by ESP32 and controlled by phone; the video covers wiring, ESP32 integration, controller setup, troubleshooting and final testing.

item.title: Leju Robotics ROBAN 2
item.description: Small bipedal humanoid for embodied-AI teaching and development. It comes in Lite and Advanced A/B/C editions built on an RK3588 compute module; the Advanced editions add a 117 TOPS module, a depth camera, LiDAR and autonomous navigation. It has hot-swap batteries and LLM Q&A.

item.title: Pollen Robotics Microduck
item.description: 25 cm open-source biped from Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face that you train yourself with reinforcement learning in simulation. It walks, sits, kicks, picks things up with its beak and can get back up after a fall. Pre-orders opened on 27 August 2026.

item.title: Hiwonder JetAuto
item.description: The Hiwonder JetAuto is a wheeled ROS robot car built on a ROS controller with a 7-inch LCD screen, SLAMTEC A1 LiDAR and a 3D depth camera. It measures 302 x 260 x 256 mm and weighs 3.5 kg. An 11.1 V 6,000 mAh lithium battery provides 60 min working time. It supports ROS1/ROS2, Python, C, C++, JavaScript and a mecanum chassis with HTS-20H serial bus servos. It costs 439.99 USD. No degrees of freedom, payload, travel speed, IP rating or charging time is published; the catalog 440 USD price and small size label are replaced by the reviewed price and dimensions.

item.title: LEGO Education SPIKE Essential
item.description: SPIKE Essential is the retired classroom construction/coding set 45345. The August 17, 2021 manufacturer announcement specifies 449 bricks, four character minifigures, a hub, motors, light matrix and color sensor, designed for ages 6+. Direct sales ended June 30, 2026, with SPIKE App support planned through June 30, 2031. The selected sources do not establish complete-build mass, dimensions, runtime or a mechanical DOF count.

item.title: LEGO Mindstorms Robot Inventor 51515
item.description: MINDSTORMS Robot Inventor 51515 is the historical 949-piece 5-in-1 construction set announced June 12, 2020 for ages 10+. It includes a six-port hub, rechargeable battery, color/distance sensing and four medium angular motors. Blast, Charlie, Tricky, Gelo and M.V.P. are alternative builds of the same kit; their movements and dimensions are not universal whole-set ratings. Current app compatibility, new-unit stock and exact price remain unverified.
